full_name: Lewis Hyde | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Journalism & Nonfiction Evelyn Green Davis Fellow Kenyon College
bio: The Richard L. Thomas Professor of Creative Writing at Kenyon College, Lewis Hyde is an essayist, translator, and cultural critic with a particular interest in the public life of the imagination.
